summary: The generated Playwright tests compile and use Playwright APIs correctly, but there are issues with the reliability and quality of selectors, and some weak assertions especially on navigation and text selectors. Await is correctly used with assertions and Locators are handled properly. Test case IDs are preserved in test titles and all GENERATED test cases are implemented.

issues.description: Selectors assume roles such as 'grid' for the product card container which may not be present in actual markup, making selectors fragile.
issues.recommendation: Verify actual roles or use data-testids or more specific stable selectors to select the product grid.

issues.description: Product cards are selected by 'div' inside the grid role which is very generic and fragile.
issues.recommendation: Use more specific selectors or test-ids to uniquely identify product cards.

issues.description: Product name is selected using getByText(/.*/), a very generic regex that might match any element, reducing assertion specificity.
issues.recommendation: Use more specific selectors or text matching patterns for product name to ensure correct elements are checked.

issues.description: Navigation validation only checks the URL contains '/product-detail', which might not be sufficiently precise to ensure correct navigation occurred.
issues.recommendation: Validate navigation by checking for presence of product detail page unique elements or more precise URL matching.

recommendations: Enhance selector stability by avoiding assumptions about roles without verification.
Improve assertion specificity especially in locating product name elements.
Add stronger navigation verification beyond a partial URL check.
Consider extracting repeated selectors into variables or helper functions to improve reuse and maintainability.
